metadata.title: Jazfer Licaros | Software Engineer
metadata.description: Jazfer Licaros is a software engineer building web applications, platform integrations, AI-enabled tools, and secure enterprise systems.

hero.eyebrow: Jazfer Licaros · Software Engineer · Cebu, Philippines
hero.description: I build web applications, connect platforms, and turn manual work into reliable software workflows.

work.description: Projects across AI-enabled applications, connected business tools, and enterprise self-service.

projects.title: Estimate Pro
projects.description: Contributed to an AI-assisted HVAC estimating platform that turns plans and email inputs into reviewable estimates.
projects.contribution: Developed pricing, approval, and email-delivery features for PDF estimates and Outlook draft replies.

projects.title: Zoho Sheet Sync
projects.description: Developed an integration between Zoho and Google Sheets to synchronize project data across connected systems.
projects.contribution: Implemented incremental updates and data reconciliation to keep information aligned between platforms.

projects.title: SongProIQ
projects.description: Contributed to an AI-powered songwriting coaching application built with Next.js.
projects.contribution: Enhanced conversational AI mentoring and audio analysis to support useful songwriting feedback.

projects.title: Self Account Management
projects.description: Built an enterprise self-service portal for password resets and account recovery, reducing reliance on manual support workflows.
projects.contribution: Developed secure .NET APIs and an Angular frontend with Azure AD SSO and role-based access control.

projects.title: Company Policy Q&A
projects.description: A customer-facing RAG project using company-policy PDFs as the knowledge source.
projects.contribution: Built the APIs, frontend, and backend; used Azure AI Studio and an OpenAI mini model. Checked answers manually against the relevant document topics.

projects.title: Water Billing System 2.0
projects.description: Reengineered a water billing system with a Django backend, improved database design, secure administration, and a responsive Bootstrap interface.

projects.title: Flood Monitoring AI
projects.description: Captured and labeled 1,300+ flood images, trained a segmentation model, and connected water-level data to a Flutter monitoring app through Firebase.

paragraphs: I'm Jazfer, a software engineer with experience in enterprise systems, full-stack development, and AI-enabled applications. I enjoy connecting the pieces: the application, the data, and the tools people use every day.

My work spans building secure self-service tools, supporting 15+ enterprise applications, and developing integrations that reduce manual work. I graduated with a BS in Information Technology from Cebu Technological University in 2024.
Outside of coding, you'll often find me playing guitar, exploring tech, or working on a personal project.

skills.description: A full-stack foundation, with a focus on connecting applications and making everyday workflows better.

contact.description: Let's talk about software, integrations, or an idea worth building.
